POSITIVE REVIEWS (praising the burger, food quality, drinks, atmosphere):
- Multiple reviews describe the burger as "the best burger I've ever had" or "one of the best burgers in Philly"
- Reviews consistently praise the duck fat fries
- Many reviews highlight excellent cocktails and impressive whiskey selection

NEGATIVE/MIXED REVIEWS (criticizing price, wait times, space, service issues, burger quality):

- Complaints about cramped, small space

- Reviews noting both positives and negatives

Quantitative assessment:
Looking through the dataset, the overwhelming majority of reviews are positive or very positive about the food quality, particularly the burgers. Even reviews that criticize aspects like price, wait times, or space typically acknowledge the food quality is excellent. The most common criticisms are about logistics (wait times, cramped space, no reservations) rather than food quality.

The claim states "majority positive reviews" - this appears to be supported by the dataset. The vast majority of reviews praise the food, particularly the burgers and fries, even when they mention drawbacks. Positive sentiment about the core product (food) dominates the dataset.
